sections.content: The plan defines R0-R4 acceptance recovery requirements, hash-bound prepared inputs, persisted run state, constrained refresh behavior, historical replay, and immutable evidence.
sections.title: Acceptance requirements

sections.content: The migration utility materializes declared RED test templates only for R0-R2, rejects conflicting files, and emits non-authorizing JSON test paths.
sections.title: Migration bridge

sections.content: Terminal and validator tooling map slices to tests and source inputs, bind candidate identities to repository content, validate lifecycle and knowledge context, and publish completion evidence only after a full successful run.
sections.title: Validation tooling
